podcast.body: Released on December 7, 1984, the charity single "Do They Know It's Christmas?" quickly achieved immense success. It entered the UK charts at number one on December 15th and held that position for five weeks, selling over three million copies in the UK alone, making it one of the biggest-selling UK singles ever. Additionally, it sold one million copies in the US. This commercial success marked the significant beginning of Band-Aid as a major charitable endeavor. "On December the 15th, it entered the charts at number one, and it stayed there for five weeks, selling more than three million copies, making it one of the biggest selling UK singles of all time."
